blockers: bf47ebd (DOS-159) wraps the sheet panel in a content-sized KeyboardAvoidingView (frontend/libs/ui/src/native/feedback.tsx:223-236, `width:'100%'`, no flex) between the flex-end backdrop and the `maxHeight:'86%'` panel. (a) Yoga resolves the 86% against the KAV's available height in both passes: the measure pass clamps the panel at 0.86·H and sizes the KAV to that, the final pass lays the KAV out Exactly at that size and re-resolves 86% against it — every native Sheet on iOS and Android ends at 86% of its own content height, bodies that fit now scroll, and a ~14%-of-sheet scrim gap opens under the panel where a tap closes the sheet (the DOS-152 harm moved one row down). (b) Android behavior='height' (RN 0.86.3 KeyboardAvoidingView.js:244-247) sets `height: initialFrameHeight - overlap, flex:0` on the KAV itself; a box pinned to the bottom by the backdrop's flex-end only gets shorter in place and cannot rise, and when the sheet is shorter than Gboard its height goes <= 0 and the panel vanishes. The comment 'Android already resizes the window' contradicts the finding (ReactModalHostView.kt:332 asks ADJUST_RESIZE but :395 makes the dialog edge-to-edge, ignored on API 35+, and nothing applies ime() insets). Fix: KAV `style={{ flex: 1, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }} pointerEvents="box-none"`, backdrop keeps flex:1 + colour only, behavior='padding' on both platforms (drop Platform), fix both comment blocks, update parity.test.ts:308-310 (import set) and :359-370 (behavior string); then the Android and iOS walks before merge.
